articles.title: Russia pounds Ukrainian cities, spares energy targets for first time since Trump 'ceasefire'

articles.title: Trump’s use of Russian diesel fuel, at Ukraine’s expense, sparks controversy in the US
articles.description: Donald Trump’s plan to import Russian diesel despite Western sanctions has sparked fierce criticism in Washington, including from Republicans, as high fuel prices and the upcoming midterm elections put pressure on his administration. His approach to the Ukraine war has also drawn controversy, with calls for Kyiv to hold elections and claims of an energy ceasefire announced without clear agreement from the parties involved. FRANCE 24's Douglas Herbert has the analysis.

articles.title: IMF global economic forecast shows 'resilience under strain'

articles.description: Spain’s King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia visited Ceuta for the first time in 14 years on Tuesday, as the North African enclave grapples with the aftermath of a mass migrant influx.
